Honestly, cable flys are a good one to love. The constant tension through the whole range is why you feel that burn, and it makes them a solid way to finish off chest after your presses. Just keep the weight light enough that you control the stretch at the bottom and don't let your shoulders roll forward. Chasing the burn is fine, but the main driver is still adding reps or weight over the weeks, so let the fly numbers creep up too.

Want me to look at how your chest work has been going lately?
